name: Defeat the Darkness DATE!
source:
Moving sucks. It always does. I go to school and meet a new set of faces that are just going to change next year. I've learned to stop caring about them. Dad says I need to make friends this time, or be sent to military school. He knows what happened to my brother Owen when he went, and clearly doesn't care.

I throw my books into my old backpack, a marketing piece for "The Adventures of Sir Beaumont," a tv show from my childhood that plays suspiciously often here in this rapidly-modernizing village. He's the only thing that's followed me this whole time, and maybe it'll help strike up a conversation or two when I get to North Town High...

[From [url=https://maho-studio.itch.io/defeat-the-darkness-date]itch.io[/url]]

A high-school AU spinoff of the comedy/isekai webseries, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uAdTRRmR_UI&list=PLyrIVUR5VXKDo-Rohe0Z5rzlt216WKbHg]Defeat the Darkness[/url].
translation:
搬家很糟糕。总是如此。我去学校遇到了一批新面孔，这些面孔明年就会发生变化。我已经学会不再关心他们。爸爸说我这次要交朋友，不然就被送去军校。他知道我哥哥欧文去时发生了什么事，而且显然并不关心。

我把书扔进我的旧背包里，这是《博蒙特爵士历险记》的营销作品，这是一部我童年时代的电视节目，在这个快速现代化的村庄里经常以可疑的方式播放。他是唯一一个一直跟着我的人，也许当我到达北镇高中时，它会帮助我开始一两次谈话……

[来自[url=https://maho-studio.itch.io/defeat-the-darkness-date]itch.io[/url]]

喜剧/异界网络系列的高中AU衍生剧，[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uAdTRRmR_UI&list=PLyrIVUR5VXKDo-Rohe0Z5rzlt216WKbHg]击败黑暗[/url]。
